svg.text: The top ten is easy; player 31,402,118's rank needs a structure that keeps ranks
Redis sorted set per board: top-N and rank in
DB is the source of truth; boards rebuildable

skip list: rank and range in O(log n)
Score service → DB + ZADD/ZINCRBY; API serves
ZREVRANGE and ZREVRANK; cache in front.
COUNT(*) WHERE score > mine scans millions of rows per
Shard by score range, or percentiles for the long
Fetch friends' scores on read, sort in memory.
"Each board is a Redis sorted set, so top 100
and my rank are O(log n); the scores table is the
source of truth and can rebuild any board, and
only game servers can submit signed results."
